content.bridge_context: Building on Grade 6 adventure themes, this chapter explores the thrill and fear of the unknown through a tunnel journey.

units.title: Understanding Adventure
units.explanation: Adventure involves stepping out of one's comfort zone and facing challenges.
units.dual_language_instruction: Discuss what adventure means to you. / चर्चा करें कि आपके लिए साहसिक कार्य का क्या अर्थ है।

units.title: Atmosphere and Mood
units.explanation: Setting the scene with words that evoke feeling, like 'dark', 'echo', or 'mysterious'.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify words that describe the tunnel. / सुरंग का वर्णन करने वाले शब्दों की पहचान करें।
